cross_verification.note_en: Fetched the official Tonga Embassy in China (tongaembassycn.gov.to, a gov.to government domain, Immigration Division / Ministry of Foreign Affairs) visitor-visa page directly. It states only that 'a most recent passport photo' is required, with no numeric size, background colour, or head-height specification. This is consistent with the finding for to-passport: Tonga's official documentation does not appear to publish ICAO-style numeric photo standards; applicants are told to bring a 'recent' photo without further technical detail. Left unverified rather than substituting third-party-sourced numbers.
